title: Roast Beef, Swiss & Horseradish Ciabatta
headnote: Sandwich developed in conversation on June 14, 2026. Untested: no confirmed tasting feedback was recovered. Use the cookbook's separate Fresh Horseradish Cream Sauce recipe (fresh-horseradish-cream-sauce). Makes 1 sandwich; deli meat weight is a suggested serving amount rather than an original measured quantity.

ingredientGroups.title: Sandwich
items: 120–150 g thinly sliced roast beef (suggested; original conversation said a generous portion)
Fresh Horseradish Cream Sauce (see standalone recipe: fresh-horseradish-cream-sauce), enough to spread both sides

steps: Prepare the Fresh Horseradish Cream Sauce using its standalone cookbook recipe (fresh-horseradish-cream-sauce).
Slice the ciabatta and lightly toast the cut sides.
If using leftover roast beef, warm it briefly in a little broth over low heat so it stays tender; drain before assembling. Deli-sliced roast beef can be used as is.
Spread the horseradish cream sauce on both cut sides of the ciabatta.
Layer on a generous amount of roast beef, Swiss cheese, arugula, and optional caramelized onions.
Close the sandwich and serve immediately. If desired, warm the cheese briefly before adding the arugula.
